prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game texture: one circular analog industrial speed gauge face, facing exactly straight at camera, zero tilt and zero perspective, centered perfectly at canvas center. Square transparent RGBA canvas, 1024×1024. Circle outer diameter 90% of canvas, equal clean transparent margins. Beautiful brushed dark blue-grey steel rim with subtle brass inner bevel, ivory enamel dial, very restrained realistic glass sheen at upper-left rim, soft material detail matching a carefully illustrated mechanical workshop. Main face completely unobstructed. Black thin evenly spaced tick marks along a 270-degree arc from lower-left 7:30 position clockwise through left/top/right to lower-right 4:30 position; small fine ticks with some longer major ticks. NO numerals, NO letters, NO units. Very important: NO needle, NO central hub or hole, NO fixed green/red/yellow sector. Leave inner white/ivory face mostly blank for a separate moving green band and red needle that game code will render. The mathematical center of the circular rim is precisely canvas center (512,512), since a separately rendered needle rotates about that point. Rim can have tiny steel screws at 10 and 2 o'clock confined to the outer metal rim. No gauge stand, no housing side, no pedestal, no background, no floor, no cast shadow outside circle. Only one front-facing circle, crisp large-readable decorative scale. Avoid bright glare over the dial interior and avoid all text or decorative symbols. Do not bake any colored range marking.
